entries.name: G0C.ORDERS
entries.note: Parse the orders JSON String into the Vector of order Records.

entries.name: G0A.BSTEP
entries.body: 'G0A.SK' BIND 'G0A.SA' BIND [ '(' '[' ')' ']' ] [ 'O' 'O' '(' '[' ] RECORD G0A.SK GET 'G0A.SQ' BIND G0A.SA G0A.SK 2 COLLECT JOIN G0A.SA CHARS -1 DROP JOIN 'X' G0A.SA CHARS -1 GET G0A.SQ EQ SELECT G0A.SQ 'O' EQ SELECT
entries.note: bracket-matching step: stack String (base '#', failure 'X') and a bracket char -> next stack String

entries.name: R1C.REVENUE
entries.body: [ 'XR' BIND XR 'qty' GET XR 'price' GET MUL 0 XR 'price' GET NIL? NOT SELECT ] MAP 0 [ ADD ] FOLD
entries.note: Orders Vector -> exact total of qty times price over the orders that have a price.

entries.name: R1D.USTEP
entries.body: 'R1D.UK' BIND 'R1D.US' BIND R1D.US CHARS -1 DROP JOIN R1D.US R1D.UK 2 COLLECT JOIN R1D.US CHARS -1 GET [ ')' ']' '(' '[' ] [ '(' '[' 'O' 'O' ] RECORD R1D.UK GET EQ SELECT
entries.note: pair-cancelling step: reduction stack String (base '#') and a bracket char -> next stack; a closer pops a matching opener on top, anything else is pushed

entries.name: R1D.USTACKS
entries.body: 'R1D.UV' BIND '#' 1 COLLECT R1D.UV CHARS '#' [ R1D.USTEP ] SCAN CONCAT
entries.note: bracket String -> Vector of reduction stacks after each prefix, the empty prefix ('#') first; a prefix is balanced exactly when its stack is '#'

entries.name: R1A.GAPMASK
entries.note: Vector -> same-length Vector of 1 where NIL, 0 where present

entries.name: R1A.ARGMAX
entries.body: 'R1A.AR' BIND R1A.AR KEYS 0 R1A.AR VALUES SUB ORDER 0 GET GET
entries.note: Record of numbers -> key with the largest value, earliest key on ties

entries.name: R1D.CAPITALIZE
entries.body: LOWER CHARS 'R1D.TC' BIND R1D.TC 0 GET UPPER 1 COLLECT R1D.TC 1 DROP CONCAT JOIN
entries.note: non-empty word -> the word with its first letter upper case and the rest lower case
